title: print: Don't add "_type" metadata field to JSON output formats
description:
The "_type" metadata field was deprecated in ElasticSearch 6.0.0
(released in November 2017 and EOL), and has been completely removed
from both ElasticSearch and OpenSearch:

https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/7.17/mapping-type-field.html
https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/7.17/removal-of-types.html
https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/removal-of-types.html
https://github.com/opensearch-project/opensearch/issues/1940

Note at one point we had "pcap_file" and had to change it to "doc" as
that was the only type supported:
commit ccf9820ea7575edf1d4192b3f119769a6a6819dd

Ping #19657
